text:
Maya L: FYI Bronte Systems renewal is stuck on procurement. They want a 6-month amendment but expect the same per-seat price as the 12mo. Procurement insists on an original wet-signed PO + vendor code. CFO is traveling until next Wed. :sweat_smile:
procurement-bot: Created draft amendment BR-2026-6MO v1 - https://contracts.internal/BR-2026-6MO (pending legal)
Diego S: Sales note: rep verbally committed to preserving the 12mo unit price if they sign within the quarter. Need to confirm in writing.
Rita N: Procurement email says courier pickup for originals is earliest Thu and they'll scan/send a PDF sooner. They also asked for our vendor onboarding form.
AR-Desk: AR checklist: need PO number, vendor code, and current W-9. If they want Net30 instead of upfront, AR manager approval required. Provisional billing possible only with PO number + signed delegation email.
Nina C: Customer is mid-onboarding; they'd like us to spin up test Dedicated nodes for pilot tests before final signature so they can validate throughput. They asked if we can enable pilot without enabling full capacity billing.
Legal-Escalation: Legal will allow pilot provisioning but requires a short clause in the amendment stating work is at customer's risk and that invoicing for Dedicated hardware will not occur until executed amendment is received. Also need delegated authority email if signer isn't CFO.
Maya L: Sounds similar to other renewals, but we should avoid promising the 12mo price until contract updated. Can we accept scanned PO + scanned W-9 for provisional steps?
AR-Desk: Yes, scanned W-9 + scanned wet PO with PO number lets us open an AR ticket and set a billing hold. Hardware enablement requires original PO on file; pilot-level provisioning can proceed on scanned docs only.
Diego S: I'll ask rep to get an email from the CFO or an exec delegate confirming authority and the pricing confirmation. If CFO won't email, ask for delegation letter on company letterhead.
Rita N: Procurement also needs our vendor code: RW-2348. I'll send them the onboarding form now.
Nina C: Customer agreed to scanned PO by EOD tomorrow and courier originals by Thu afternoon. They also want a +10 seat temporary increase during pilot; rep to confirm count.
Legal-Escalation: Draft clause suggestion we can insert: "Customer acknowledges that certain onboarding activities may commence upon receipt of scanned PO and W-9; such activities are at Customer's sole risk and shall not be considered acceptance of the amendment. Billing for Dedicated capacity will not commence until the executed amendment and original PO are received." Send me the exact placement and I'll slot it in.
Maya L: Action items:
- Diego: secure delegated authority email or delegation letter (due tomorrow)
- Rita: send vendor onboarding form + vendor code RW-2348 to Bronte procurement (sent)
- Nina: confirm pilot seat count (+10?) and prepare provisioning checklist (pilot-only flags)
- AR-Desk: set up provisional AR ticket on receipt of scanned PO + W-9; confirm billing hold process
- Legal-Escalation: patch clause into BR-2026-6MO and confirm indemnity/data clauses remain intact
Diego S: Will push rep for written pricing confirmation. If customer insists on 12mo price for 6mo term, sales needs written approval from VP Sales for the concession.
AR-Desk: Noted. If concession approved, capture in amendment as a one-time pricing exception and route to finance for revenue recognition note.
Maya L: If any of these slip past Friday, we should offer a 5-business-day extension on pricing to avoid churn. I'll follow up Wed morning. :spiral_calendar:
Rita N: I've got courier pickup scheduled tentatively for Thu 10am. Will update once label is created.
Nina C: I'll prepare the pilot provisioning playbook and include a checklist for turning off auto-scale to avoid incurring full capacity charges prematurely.
Legal-Escalation: Added clause to draft and unlocked for AR insertion. Re-review once Diego confirms delegated authority.
Maya L: Thanks everyone — repost contract link when updated and I'll log notes into Renewals playbook under "provisional-onboard" pattern.
